oneLiner: A dashboard that helps PMs re-orient when switching between projects, showing the last decision made, blockers, and who's waiting on what.
problem: Product managers lose critical context when juggling multiple projects, leading to repeated questions, missed blockers, and stalled dependencies. Switching between projects requires digging through emails, Slack, and project tools to get oriented.
coreFlow: User logs in and views dashboard with all active projects
User selects a project to view its context snapshot
User reviews last key decision, current blockers, and pending dependencies
User marks items as resolved or adds quick updates
User can set 'context refresh reminders' before switching projects

screens.name: Dashboard Home
screens.purpose: Display all active projects with a quick-glance status card showing last decision, blocker count, and waiting-on count

screens.name: Project Context View
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a single project showing timeline of last 3 decisions, active blockers with owners, and dependencies blocked on this project

screens.name: Blockers & Dependencies
screens.purpose: Focused view of what's blocking progress and what's waiting on this PM, with action buttons to resolve or escalate

screens.name: Decision Timeline
screens.purpose: Chronological view of recent decisions with context, stakeholders involved, and any follow-up actions

screens.name: Settings & Integrations
screens.purpose: Connect to Jira, Linear, Slack, or email to auto-populate blockers and decisions

outOfScope: Project creation or full project management functionality
